watches.name: BELVEDERE DAY
watches.description: Stainless Steel Case White Dial Adorned with an elegant and timeless white dial, the lighter version of the Belvedere invites you to face the day with a light and easy attitude. True to Carl Suchy & Söhne's spirit of quiet innovation, the Belvedere Day features a unique jumping date window that shifts position daily, transforming the dial's face every twenty-four hours. The skeletonised hands and indices, generously filled with Super-LumiNova®, ensure flawless legibility. The 40.8 mm stainless-steel case is subtly animated by the interplay of polished and satin-finished surfaces.

specsRaw.Movement: automatic, 42 hours power reserve, 28,800 vph, 21 jewels, CSS201 (customised Dubois Dépraz DD90000)

watches.name: TABLE WALTZ
watches.description: Limited to ten pieces The Table Waltz is an exceptional creation by Carl Suchy & Söhne, a strictly limited-edition table clock housing a specially developed in-house movement, handcrafted to the highest standards of Viennese watchmaking. Its dark, silk-matte case flows seamlessly into the movement, achieving a rare unity of form and function that defines its quiet elegance and commanding presence.

watches.name: WALTZ Nº1
watches.description: Black Case Black Dial The Black dial of the Waltz N°1 features a geometric pattern, which is divided in half by vertical and horizontal striping. The rotating small seconds indicator, in the shape of a waltzing disc at six o’clock, is cut out of the striping and is thus aligned with the rest of the dial once per minute as it waltzes in a perfect circle. It’s a tribute to the dancing rhythm of the Viennese Waltz – and to the Viennese savoir-vivre, where not every second counts.

watches.name: TABLE WALTZ TOURBILLON
watches.description: Limited to ten pieces The Table Waltz Tourbillon is a rare masterpiece, one that sits at the intersection of haute horlogerie and Viennese craftsmanship. Limited to just ten pieces, it features an in-house tourbillon movement, made and engineered entirely in Austria. Its case, milled from a single block of brass and finished by hand in partnership with the legendary Viennese glassmaker J. & L. Lobmeyr, makes it as much a work of art as a feat of engineering.

specsRaw.Case: nickel plated plated brass, inside colorless glossy lacquered

watches.name: TABLE WALTZ JUBILEE
watches.description: Limited to ten pieces The Table Waltz Jubilee was created to mark a defining milestone: the 200th anniversary of Carl Suchy & Söhne. Every detail speaks to the finest traditions of Viennese craftsmanship, from the hand-polished and engraved glass panels on the front and back, realized in partnership with the legendary J. & L. Lobmeyr, to the conical brass case into which they fit with effortless precision. Together, they frame a light-flooded stage for the seemingly weightless, skeletonised in-house movement CS-T1, its brilliance further heightened by a colourless gloss finish applied to the interior of the case.

specsRaw.Case: nickel plated plated brass, inside colorless glossy lacquered

watches.name: WALTZ Nº1 ORNAMENT EDITION
watches.description: Stainless Steel Case Silver/Black Dial The Waltz N°1 Ornament Edition does not follow a decorative motif. Its dial is based on a geometric grid of concentric lines. The numerals 12, 3, 6 and 9 are not applied elements but integral components of this structure. The rotating Waltzing Disc at six o’clock completes the linear composition once every minute. Slender black hands integrate seamlessly into the composition without disrupting its graphic clarity. The ultra thin Calibre CSS-A1, with its geometrically skeletonised bridges, mirrors the dial. Construction becomes a continuous principle.
